title: After-hours eggless cake pickup near Rosehill and Camellia — open till 10pm
summary:
Finish work at 6, need a cake by 7? Most Western Sydney bakeries close by then.

Harris Park stays open until 10pm, seven days a week. Custom eggless cakes for Rosehill and Camellia families — six sizes, 15 flavours, buttercream, fondant, or ganache. 100% eggless, every single one.

48 hours minimum notice. That's what fresh baking actually takes.

WhatsApp your order: +61 425 697 725. We speak Hindi and Gujarati.
